Here is the uncomfortable truth about enterprise AI: the technology works. Most organizations do not.

Oxford Economics research published this month found that the biggest obstacle to scaling AI is not model performance. It is business readiness — specifically data quality, process maturity, and governance infrastructure.

Fast-growth companies have the largest opportunity to capture value from AI. Most are not doing it. And the reason has nothing to do with which model they are using.

Every company today has access to frontier AI capabilities. The differentiator is whether your data is clean enough to feed those models reliable inputs, whether your processes are documented well enough for AI to execute within them, and whether your governance frameworks are built for autonomous decision-making rather than just human oversight.

If your 2027 AI budget is mostly allocated to model licensing and tooling, it is likely misallocated. The highest-ROI investment for most organizations is not a better model — it is better data, clearer processes, and stronger governance.

The model is the commodity. Readiness is the moat.
